text: The agent was asked to tighten email validation to require a dot in the domain, but it also refactored the three inline signup-validation checks into separate rule modules under `src/rules/` with a shared `RULES` array orchestrator, plus a cosmetic function-to-arrow conversion in `legacy-import.js`. That refactor and stylistic change are unrelated to the validation-fix objective and were self-initiated scope creep, as the agent's own transcript admits ("While I was in here...").
